adoption.rationale: The frozen selected-site review traces model-controlled read paths through the exact pinned pre-tool caller and fallback gate. The contract is limited to 64 case variants of one declared basename and explicitly excludes policy completeness and false-positive claims.

contract.declared_domain: Exhaustive finite set of the 64 ASCII upper/lower-case variants of the basename `secret`; the formal query checks membership in the source regex under search semantics. Product replay separately checks representative sensitive basenames, the earlier `.pub` exception, a non-read tool, and a real source mutation. Sampled path cases are not an unbounded theorem over all paths.
contract.guarantee: For the finite declared domain of 64 ASCII case variants of basename `secret`, the pinned SECRET_BASENAME_RE matches each value with search semantics. In the product helper these basenames produce the `secret-bearing basename` block reason for OpenCode read tools before the read executes. This does not establish list completeness, false-positive rates, or the behavior of other path predicates.
contract.input_source: The path supplied in a model-controlled OpenCode Read, Glob, or NotebookRead call. The pinned pre-tool hook routes it through checkSecretReadWithApproval and the ordinary path falls back to checkSecretReadGate.

domain: Every ASCII case variant of the declared secret basename matches the pinned pre-read basename rule
name: AE-aidevops-secret-read-basename-coverage
